# Warden — A Sandbox Runtime for MCP Servers

> Run third-party MCP servers in OS-native sandboxes. Only the files, hosts, and environment variables you explicitly grant are accessible.

## What is Warden?

Warden is an open-source sandbox runtime for MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers. It runs third-party code inside OS-native sandboxes — bubblewrap on Linux, Seatbelt on macOS, AppContainer + WFP on Windows, Docker as fallback — with deny-by-default controls on filesystem, network, and environment access.

## Key Features

- **Deny-by-default sandboxing**: Servers only get what you explicitly grant
- **OS-native backends**: Linux (bubblewrap), macOS (Seatbelt), Windows (AppContainer + WFP + ETW)
- **Single YAML policy**: Readable in one sitting, describes all grants
- **Fail-closed**: Missing backends fail loudly, never silently skip sandboxing
- **Audit logging**: Every blocked access is logged
- **Interactive approval**: `--approve` mode for discovering grants at runtime
- **No daemon required**: Single static binary, zero dependencies

## Quick Install

```bash
npm install -g warden-sandbox-cli
```

Or download the latest binary:
```bash
curl -LO https://github.com/Prof-bilal/Warden/releases/latest/download/warden-linux-amd64
```
